question: Are the subscribers to this platform event keeping up, and who do they run as?

steps.name: subscribers
steps.soql: SELECT Name, Type, Topic, Position, Tip, Status, Retries, LastError FROM EventBusSubscriber WHERE Topic = '{topic}'

steps.name: configs
steps.soql: SELECT DeveloperName, PlatformEventConsumerId, UserId, BatchSize FROM PlatformEventSubscriberConfig ORDER BY DeveloperName LIMIT 200

verdicts.say: A subscriber on {topic} is not running.
A subscriber on {topic} is behind the tip.
{subscribers.rows} subscriber(s) on {topic}, all running and caught up.

traps: A trigger subscriber runs as the Automated Process user unless a subscriber config names another; a config change takes effect after the subscriber is suspended and resumed.
